snippet.title: 💣 This Co-Op Roguelite Magical Store Wants to End Your Friendship
snippet.description:
Run a magical shop where your appliances are alive, emotional, and doing their best to ruin your day.
Win them over ♡♡♡ to unlock powerful teamwork bonuses while you craft items, serve demanding customers, and scramble through the weekly rush in this chaotic co-op roguelite, where new job's every shift is a test of teamwork, timing, and survival.

Can you master the art of customer service in this retail hell gameplay? 

Try this indie game free demo on Steam🕹️! You can "try again & AGAIN!" to master the art of "automotive" service and become the best Clerks in this weird "Retail Hell."
 #multiplayer #gaming #indiegame #steamgame  #gamingcommunity
